Anyone can register as a Reporter (once per wallet).\u2502 \u2502  2. Reporters submit scam reports linking an X handle   \u2502 \u2502     to on-chain evidence. Each report is an ALLEGATION. \u2502 \u2502  3. If the same handle is reported again, the second    \u2502 \u2502     submission is stored as a CORROBORATION \u2014 it adds   \u2502 \u2502     credibility but earns no reward.                    \u2502 \u2502  4. Searchers pay $5 USDC to unlock the full evidence   \u2502 \u2502     for ANY found record (regardless of status).        \u2502 \u2502  5. Admins (treasury or developer wallet) can classify  \u2502 \u2502     records: Reported \u2192 UnderReview \u2192 Verified.         \u2502 \u2514\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2518 Status model:   Reported    (0) \u2014 allegation submitted, not yet reviewed   UnderReview (1) \u2014 flagged for investigation by an admin   Verified    (2) \u2014 confirmed scam Fee model:   Any found record (any status) triggers the $5 USDC gate.   No record found = free.
